checks.message: Provisional boundary is present and marked official_boundary=false / geometry_role=provisional_constraint; replace with official redline before professional scoring.
Three required key areas are provisional; work areas match announcement values within tolerance; replace with official polygons before professional scoring.
Land-use polygons are derived from the same site boundary by deterministic partitioning: full coverage, zero gaps, zero overlaps, shared edges.
All known metrics are recalculated from submitted geometry in EPSG:4548; per-code land-use, per-phase and per-key-area breakdowns are provided.
Every source id cited in proposal.md is registered in sources.json with type, usage and limitation; provisional sources are not upgraded to official authority.

14 frozen scenario cards carry user/space, AI mechanism + human review, data boundary + failure exit, suggested human owner, minimum success evidence and red-card pause/exit; states never claim deployed or approved.
Provisional boundary precision limits are disclosed in proposal.md, visual/index.html, sources.json, assumptions.json and this self-check.
Static offline HTML visualization is generated without external dependencies, remote tiles, scripts, fonts, iframes or tracking.
A3 booklet (12 pages) and A0 boards (2 pages, 8 boards) render with CJK text layer; verified via pdftotext.
Proposal includes references to standards, design depth items, geometry, metrics, sources and assumptions; matrices are not self-justifying.
Original content is CC-BY-4.0; no photos, map screenshots, trademarks or remote assets are embedded; third-party rights are preserved.
